1→-- CORE PROTOCOL REMAKE R3 | AVATAR-SCALE FILM CAMERA
     2→-- Install as a LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
     3→-- The server alone controls gameplay. This script adds NO permanent HUD.
     4→local Players=game:GetService("Players")
     5→local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
     6→local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
     7→local UserInputService=game:GetService("UserInputService")
     8→local SoundService=game:GetService("SoundService")
     9→local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
    10→local Workspace=game:GetService("Workspace")
    11→local player=Players.LocalPlayer
    12→local cues=ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("CORE_PROTOCOL_V2_CUES",60)
    13→if not cues then
    14→	warn("[CORE PROTOCOL] Server cue channel unavailable.")
    15→	return
    16→end
    17→
    18→local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    19→gui.Name="CORE_PROTOCOL_LENS_EFFECT_ONLY"
    20→gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true
    21→gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
    22→gui.DisplayOrder=950
    23→gui.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    24→gui.Parent=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    25→local flare=Instance.new("Frame")
    26→flare.Name="EPHEMERAL_FILM_FLASH_NO_HUD"
    27→flare.BorderSizePixel=0
    28→flare.BackgroundTransparency=1
    29→flare.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
    30→flare.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
    31→flare.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,0)
    32→flare.Parent=gui
    33→-- Transient outage layer, not a permanent HUD/cover. Server also dims
    34→-- physical lamps and Lighting; this lens pass makes the video cuts readable
    35→-- for a joining client without ever changing authoritative gameplay.
    36→local gridLens=Instance.new("Frame")
    37→gridLens.Name="EPHEMERAL_IGNITION_GRID_OUTAGE_NO_HUD"
    38→gridLens.BorderSizePixel=0
    39→gridLens.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,8,18)
    40→gridLens.BackgroundTransparency=1
    41→gridLens.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
    42→gridLens.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,0)
    43→gridLens.ZIndex=1;gridLens.Parent=gui
    44→flare.ZIndex=2
    45→
    46→local HUES={
    47→	white=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),
    48→	red=Color3.fromRGB(255,48,52),
    49→	purple=Color3.fromRGB(198,91,255),
    50→	ice=Color3.fromRGB(101,225,255),
    51→}
    52→local shakeEvents={}
    53→local flashTween=nil
    54→local activeScore=nil
    55→local activeTween=nil
    56→local soundSerial=0
    57→local meltdownStartedAt=nil
    58→local initialCamera=Workspace.CurrentCamera
    59→local lastCameraFov=initialCamera and initialCamera.FieldOfView or 70
    60→-- On spawn, show the control room and reactor without the avatar filling
    61→-- the middle of the frame. V toggles regular third-person at any moment.
    62→local immersiveCamera=true
    63→local pendingAim=true
    64→local function chooseCamera(firstPerson)
    65→	immersiveCamera=firstPerson
    66→	-- Changing CameraMode alone leaves Classic zoomed INTO first person.
    67→	-- Provide a genuinely free cursor and full avatar for physical switches.
    68→	if firstPerson then
    69→		player.CameraMinZoomDistance=0.5
    70→		player.CameraMaxZoomDistance=0.5
    71→		player.CameraMode=Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
    72→		pendingAim=true
    73→	else
    74→		player.CameraMaxZoomDistance=25
    75→		player.CameraMinZoomDistance=8
    76→		player.CameraMode=Enum.CameraMode.Classic
    77→	end
    78→end
    79→chooseCamera(true)
    80→UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
    81→	if processed or input.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.V then return end
    82→	chooseCamera(not immersiveCamera)
    83→end)
    84→local function cameraAfterSpawn(character)
    85→	task.spawn(function()
    86→		local root=character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",15)
    87→		if not root then return end
    88→		task.wait(0.8)
    89→		if immersiveCamera then pendingAim=true end
    90→	end)
    91→end
    92→player.CharacterAdded:Connect(cameraAfterSpawn)
    93→if player.Character then cameraAfterSpawn(player.Character) end
    94→local function serverTime()
    95→	return Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    96→end
    97→local function briefFlash(strength,hue)
    98→	local alpha=math.clamp(tonumber(strength) or 0.3,0,1)
    99→	if flashTween then flashTween:Cancel() end
   100→	flare.BackgroundColor3=HUES[hue] or HUES.white
   101→	flare.BackgroundTransparency=1-alpha*0.84
   102→	local tweenInfo=TweenInfo.new(0.13+alpha*1.45,
   103→		Enum.EasingStyle.Quart,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
   104→	flashTween=TweenService:Create(flare,tweenInfo,
   105→		{BackgroundTransparency=1})
   106→	flashTween:Play()
   107→end
   108→local function cueShake(strength,duration)
   109→	local amount=math.clamp(tonumber(strength) or 0,0,4)
   110→	local period=math.clamp(tonumber(duration) or 1,0.1,15)
   111→	if amount<=0 then return end
   112→	shakeEvents[#shakeEvents+1]={start=serverTime(),
   113→		deadline=serverTime()+period,power=amount,duration=period}
   114→	if #shakeEvents>18 then table.remove(shakeEvents,1) end
   115→end
   116→local function silenceScore()
   117→	soundSerial=soundSerial+1
   118→	if activeTween then activeTween:Cancel();activeTween=nil end
   119→	if activeScore then
   120→		local old=activeScore
   121→		activeScore=nil
   122→		TweenService:Create(old,TweenInfo.new(1.9,
   123→			Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
   124→			{Volume=0}):Play()
   125→		task.delay(2.1,function()
   126→			if old.Parent then old:Destroy() end
   127→		end)
   128→	end
   129→end
   130→local function startScore(action,elapsed,id,stageStartedAt,roundStartedAt)
   131→	local world=Workspace:FindFirstChild("CORE_PROTOCOL_V2_WORLD")
   132→	if world and world:GetAttribute("SilentPrototype")==true then return end
   133→	if type(id)~="string" or not id:find("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then
   134→		return
   135→	end
   136→	if type(roundStartedAt)=="number" then
   137→		meltdownStartedAt=roundStartedAt
   138→	elseif not meltdownStartedAt then
   139→		meltdownStartedAt=serverTime()-(tonumber(elapsed) or 0)
   140→	end
   141→	if activeScore and activeScore.SoundId==id then return end
   142→	soundSerial=soundSerial+1
   143→	local serial=soundSerial
   144→	local previous=activeScore
   145→	local target=action=="START" and 0.28 or 0.32
   146→	local music=Instance.new("Sound")
   147→	music.Name="CORE_PROTOCOL_LOCAL_CINEMATIC_SCORE"
   148→	music.SoundId=id
   149→	music.Looped=true
   150→	music.Volume=0
   151→	music.PlaybackSpeed=1
   152→	music.Parent=SoundService
   153→	activeScore=music
   154→	-- Roblox asset permissions depend on the OWNER of each experience.
   155→	-- Mute/unavailable audio does NOT affect this independently modeled game.
   156→	local function seek()
   157→		if serial~=soundSerial or not music.Parent then return end
   158→		local offset=math.max(0,serverTime()-(
   159→			tonumber(stageStartedAt) or serverTime()))
   160→		local length=music.TimeLength
   161→		if length>0 then offset=offset%length end
   162→		music.TimePosition=offset
   163→	end
   164→	if music.IsLoaded then seek()
   165→	else
   166→		music.Loaded:Connect(function()
   167→			if serial==soundSerial then seek() end
   168→		end)
   169→	end
   170→	music:Play()
   171→	if music.IsLoaded then seek() end
   172→	activeTween=TweenService:Create(music,
   173→		TweenInfo.new(previous and 3.1 or 1.9,
   174→			Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
   175→		{Volume=target})
   176→	activeTween:Play()
   177→	if previous then
   178→		TweenService:Create(previous,TweenInfo.new(3.2,
   179→			Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
   180→			{Volume=0}):Play()
   181→		task.delay(3.4,function()
   182→			if previous.Parent then previous:Destroy() end
   183→		end)
   184→	end
   185→end
   186→local function resetFilm()
   187→	meltdownStartedAt=nil
   188→	shakeEvents={}
   189→	if flashTween then flashTween:Cancel();flashTween=nil end
   190→	flare.BackgroundTransparency=1
   191→	gridLens.BackgroundTransparency=1
   192→	silenceScore()
   193→	local camera=Workspace.CurrentCamera
   194→	if camera then camera.FieldOfView=lastCameraFov end
   195→end
   196→
   197→cues.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(command,a,b,c,d,e)
   198→	if command=="SHAKE" then
   199→  local w=Workspace:FindFirstChild("CORE_PROTOCOL_V2_WORLD")
   200→  if w and w:GetAttribute("ReactorMode")=="STARTUP" then return end
   201→  cueShake(a,b)
   202→	elseif command=="FLASH" then
   203→  local w=Workspace:FindFirstChild("CORE_PROTOCOL_V2_WORLD")
   204→  if w and w:GetAttribute("ReactorMode")=="STARTUP" then return end
   205→  briefFlash(a,b)
   206→	elseif command=="RESET" then
   207→		resetFilm()
   208→	elseif command=="MUSIC" then
   209→		if a=="STOP" then
   210→			-- A success/failed-startup/reset immediately ends camera tremor.
   211→			meltdownStartedAt=nil
   212→			silenceScore()
   213→		elseif a=="START" or a=="CROSSFADE" then
   214→			startScore(a,b,c,d,e)
   215→		end
   216→	end
   217→end)
   218→
   219→local noiseSeed=player.UserId%997
   220→local renderTag="CORE_PROTOCOL_PHYSICAL_CAMERA"
   221→pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(renderTag) end)
   222→RunService:BindToRenderStep(renderTag,
   223→	Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+1,function(dt)
   224→		local camera=Workspace.CurrentCamera
   225→		if not camera then return end
   226→		local reactor=Workspace:FindFirstChild("CORE_PROTOCOL_V2_WORLD")
   227→		local outage=reactor and reactor:GetAttribute("ReactorGridDrop")==true
   228→		local inPilot=reactor and reactor:GetAttribute("ReactorMode")=="STARTUP"
   229→		-- The physical-only first checkpoint owns no camera or overlay.
   230→		gridLens.BackgroundTransparency=(not inPilot and outage) and .46 or 1
   231→		if pendingAim and immersiveCamera then
   232→			-- One-time aim; never lock the camera during actual play.
   233→			camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(camera.CFrame.Position,
   234→				Vector3.new(-24.5,33.5,12.5))
   235→			pendingAim=false
   236→		end
   237→		if inPilot then
   238→   shakeEvents={} -- Nothing may shake during physical deployment.
   239→   if camera.FieldOfView~=lastCameraFov then
   240→    camera.FieldOfView=lastCameraFov
   241→   end
   242→   return
   243→  end
   244→		local t=serverTime()
   245→		local impulse=0
   246→		for i=#shakeEvents,1,-1 do
   247→			local event=shakeEvents[i]
   248→			if t>=event.deadline then table.remove(shakeEvents,i)
   249→			else
   250→				local remaining=(event.deadline-t)/event.duration
   251→				impulse=impulse+event.power*remaining*remaining
   252→			end
   253→		end
   254→		local continuous=0
   255→		if meltdownStartedAt then
   256→			local age=math.max(0,t-meltdownStartedAt)
   257→			local panic=math.clamp((age-85)/350,0,1)
   258→			continuous=0.025+panic*0.16
   259→			if age>=420 and age<=440 then
   260→				continuous=continuous+0.24
   261→			end
   262→		end
   263→		local intensity=math.min(4,impulse+continuous)
   264→		if intensity>0.006 then
   265→			local x=math.noise(t*12.1,noiseSeed,0)*intensity*0.72
   266→			local y=math.noise(t*14.9,noiseSeed+17,0)*intensity*0.52
   267→			local z=math.noise(t*10.2,noiseSeed+39,0)*intensity*0.31
   268→			local pitch=math.noise(t*11.1,noiseSeed+58,0)
   269→				*math.rad(1.8)*intensity
   270→			local yaw=math.noise(t*9.2,noiseSeed+74,0)
   271→				*math.rad(1.45)*intensity
   272→			local roll=math.noise(t*8.1,noiseSeed+81,0)
   273→				*math.rad(1.9)*intensity
   274→			-- Apply AFTER Roblox's ordinary camera controller each frame;
   275→			-- no permanent CFrame change accumulates across rendered frames.
   276→			camera.CFrame=camera.CFrame*CFrame.new(x,y,z)
   277→				*CFrame.Angles(pitch,yaw,roll)
   278→			camera.FieldOfView=lastCameraFov+
   279→				math.min(7,intensity*2.15)
   280→		else
   281→			if math.abs(camera.FieldOfView-lastCameraFov)>0.03 then
   282→				camera.FieldOfView=camera.FieldOfView+
   283→					(lastCameraFov-camera.FieldOfView)*
   284→					math.min(1,dt*8)
   285→			end
   286→		end
   287→	end)
   288→
   289→-- Ask for the CURRENT act on late join. The server accepts this command
   290→-- only; client cannot change any reactor state, room damage, or inventory.
   291→cues:FireServer("SYNC")
   292→print("[CORE PROTOCOL REMAKE R3] Film camera and true third person; physical reactor is server owned.")
   293→
